description.zh:
图搜实例名称。最多支持20个字符。

如果已经购买图搜实例可登录[图像搜索管控台](https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com)查看。

如果没有购买图搜实例可参考开通服务和创建实例。

> 这里的实例名称并非实例ID，使用时请区分。
description.en:
The name of the Image Search instance. The name can be up to 20 characters in length.

If you have purchased an Image Search instance, log on to the [Image Search console](https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com) to view the instance name.

If you have not purchased an Image Search instance, refer to the topics about activating the service and creating an instance.

> The instance name is not the instance ID. Make sure that you can distinguish between them.

description.zh:
图片名称，最多支持512个字符。
> - ProductId和PicName唯一确定一张图片。
- 如果多次添加图片具有相同的ProductId和PicName，以最后一次添加为准，前面添加的图片将被覆盖。
description.en:
The image name. The name can be up to 512 characters in length.
> - The combination of ProductId and PicName uniquely identifies an image.
- If you add images with the same ProductId and PicName multiple times, the last added image prevails and the previously added images are overwritten.

description.zh:
商品ID，最多支持512个字符。

>一个商品可以有多张图片。
description.en:
The product ID. The ID can be up to 512 characters in length.

> A product can have multiple images.

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于向图像搜索实例中删除图片信息。

> 如果指定图片在图像搜索实例中不存在，该接口依然会返回成功。不能用返回结果来判断图片是否存在。

### QPS限制
删除操作默认的并发量为20，也就是每秒钟最多处理20个删除请求。
descriptions.en:
### Operation description
This operation is used to delete image information from an Image Search instance.

> If the specified image does not exist in the Image Search instance, this operation still returns a success response. You cannot use the response to determine whether the image exists.

### QPS limit
The default concurrency for delete operations is 20, which means a maximum of 20 delete requests can be processed per second.
